range-lang-a1.source: let x := 14; let y := 12; let width := 60; [| [[y * width] + x]]
let a := #wall; let b := #wall; [| [[a printString] = [b printString]]]
let map := {734 -> #floor}; let key := 734; [| [map at: key]]
let map := {734 -> #floor}; let key := 735; [| [map at: key ifAbsent: [| #wall]]]
let a := 12345; let flag := true; [| [flag ifTrue: [| a] ifFalse: [| 0]]]
let yes := [| 12345]; let no := [| 0]; let flag := true; [| [flag ifTrue: yes ifFalse: no]]
let f := [:x | x]; let a := 12345; [| [f value: a]]
let range := [0 to: 1079]; let index := 734; [| [range at: index]]

harness_note: Two fresh processes per variant, serial ABBA, automatic GC enabled for timings. Generic probe setup and explicit collection outside timers; separate one-invocation allocation counts. See prior language-cost receipt for exact native probe source. Real Logue functions driven in a drained PTY, 120 turns and one floor round trip.
failed_setup_note: Directly loading task-control-smoke.birnam only defines its fixture. Calling it without the native observer fixture reports the same 12 failures on baseline and candidate. Those attempts are excluded; the actual native task_control test supplies the observer and passes all177 checks.
limits: No claim that 38% initial map speedup applies to every floor transition: collection moves between phases. Aggregate phase CPU and full round trips are included. Range do/fold no longer invoke size/at; indexed detect is unchanged. Bound reads and overflow termination follow the new accepted contract.
